recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No current FHIR source change is needed for FHIR-6115 unless MnM later decides to change Address.district semantics.
issue_request: FHIR-6115 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification MnM change request from DSTU1 asking for additional Address parts for international postal addresses. The final resolution added district, declined a separate county element, and said county should be represented in city when a region uses county in place of municipality.
initial_application: The issue was historically applied by commit 998d5a5f9389484135209ed1b232317d60d83aee, '#6115 - add Address.district,' matching the Jira comment that recorded svn revision 5932.
additional_context: Address is active in the current build because source/fhir.ini lists Address under [types] and marks Address normative. The directly related FHIR-9057 typo correction later fixed the same usage note, and the 2018 Zulip Address.district discussion supports the current interpretation that municipality goes in city while county/district is for a larger region below state/province/territory.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit on the combined branch. The authoritative source/datatypes/address.xml row for Address.district remains present as a 0..1 string with definition 'The name of the administrative area (county)' and the required note about conveying county in city when county is used in place of municipality.

related_jiras.note: Later published typo correction to the Address.district usage note introduced by FHIR-6115.
